# Budgets

**Parity grade: B** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/budgets@v1.53.1` · last audited 2026-10-18 (`4ae40e79e`)

### Known gaps

- CalculatedSpend: spend is metered from emulated resources only for EC2 instances, EBS volumes, S3 storage and requests, Lambda and DynamoDB on-demand units; every other service contributes the 90-day synthetic seed catalogue
- CalculatedSpend: RI_UTILIZATION and RI_COVERAGE are computed from EC2 reservations, but nothing seeds EC2 ReservedInstancesOfferings (services/ec2/reserved_instances.go:112) so no reservation can be purchased through the API; SAVINGS_PLANS_UTILIZATION and SAVINGS_PLANS_COVERAGE report 0 PERCENTAGE because no Savings Plans service exists
- CostFilters/FilterExpression: CostCategories and ProductAttributes clauses and the CostFilters CostCategory and SubscriptionId keys do not narrow spend (cost category rules carry no expression and ledger rows carry no product attributes or subscription)
- CostTypes: charge types other than Usage enter the ledger only through RecordCharge; no emulated service produces Tax, Support, Credit, Refund or RIFee lines, so the Include* flags change spend only for such recorded entries
- Alerting: topic policies granting budgets.amazonaws.com are not checked; evaluator cadence is 1 minute versus AWS several times a day
- ExecuteBudgetAction: ExecutionRoleArn must exist in IAM when the action runs (a missing role fails the execution) but its trust policy is never evaluated or assumed; SSM actions start AWS-Stop*/Start* automation documents through the SSM backend
- BillingViewArn: format-checked only; HealthStatus is always HEALTHY
- AccessDeniedException, ThrottlingException, InternalErrorException, ExpiredNextTokenException, BillingViewHealthStatusException, ServiceQuotaExceededException: never raised
